goal: Catch bugs in coin selection where CoinGrinder incorrectly reports completion status.
Ensures unit tests and fuzz harnesses assert the completion flag upon exhaustion or reaching limits.
agreement: Verified by testing that mutants fail the new tests on macOS arm64 (Zippo76)
Nonblocking suggestion: add a unit test for CoinGrinder hitting the attempt limit (Zippo76)

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because it adds test assertions without altering wallet behavior or user-facing features.
Kills two synthetic mutation mutants in test suites but addresses no real-world wallet bugs.
